Class RewardModel

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.curriculum.RewardModel
public final class RewardModel extends Object
Turns ground truth about a step into a reward and updates the metrics. One instance follows one episode at a time; call endEpisode(Tally, boolean, boolean) between episodes.

      public void startComboed(StageSpec stage, int hits, Tally tally)
      The episode begins in the middle of the opponent's combo (a combo drill): it has just landed this many hits in a row, before the first step. Those hits are not charged, since nothing the agent did brought them on, but they count towards the combo exactly as if they had been.
